summary: test_duplicate_error_identifies_external_file_and_remediation exercises real discover_workflows() against dynamically written external files for every built-in name, asserting exact error text (file path + removal directive) and confirming _skip_duplicates doesn't swallow it; verified via 4 hand-constructed violating reimplementations (missing path, silent skip, missing removal directive, flag-swallows-error) that all fail the test's assertions.
